mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kog'Maw is about to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: For @TooltipPassiveDuration@ seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, can move through units, and gains <speed>10% Move Speed</speed>, increasing to <speed>@TooltipPassiveMS*100@% Move Speed</speed> over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals <trueDamage>@PassiveDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.
Kog'Maw's next Living Artillery will cost additional Mana.
This target has reduced Armor and Magic Resist.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Upon dying, Kog'Maw starts a chain reaction in his body which causes him to detonate after 4 seconds; dealing magic damage to surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: For @passiveDuration@ seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, is Ghosted, and increases his <speed>Move Speed</speed> by @TooltipMS*100@% over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals <trueDamage>@PassiveDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.
This unit has reduced movement speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and leaves a trail of ooze for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowAmount*100@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Passive: Increases Kog'Maw's Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains @PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds @ArmorShred@ Armor and Magic Resist for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw fires a living artillery shell at a great distance dealing damage and revealing targets.  Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional mana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid from a great distance that lands shortly after launch. Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage , increased to @ChampionTotalDamage@ magic damage to Champions and reveals enemies for @VisionDebuffDuration@ seconds.

Subsequent artillery shots within @ManaCostDuration@ seconds cost @BaseCost@ additional Mana (max: @ManaCostCap@ Mana).
Kog'Maw has increased attack range, and his attacks deal a percent of the target's maximum Health as magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kog'Maw gains @Range@ Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalHealthDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for @Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals a maximum of <magicDamage>@MonsterDamageCap@ magic damage</magicDamage> to Monsters.</rules>
